title: NovaCorp Travel & Expense Reimbursement Policy
content:
NovaCorp Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy — Q1 2025 Edition

1. SCOPE
This policy covers all business-related expenses incurred by employees in the course of their duties, including travel, accommodation, meals, client entertainment, and office supplies.

2. PRE-APPROVAL
Expenses over $500 per transaction require pre-approval from the employee's manager. International travel expenses require VP approval in addition to manager approval.

3. TRAVEL
Air travel: Economy class for domestic flights under 6 hours. Business class permitted for international flights over 8 hours with VP approval. Preferred booking through the company travel portal. Hotel: Up to $250 per night for domestic travel, $350 per night for major international cities. Rental car: Economy or compact class preferred.

4. MEAL ALLOWANCES
Breakfast: $20 per day. Lunch: $30 per day. Dinner: $60 per day. Alcohol is not reimbursable unless part of approved client entertainment with manager sign-off. Meals with clients are reimbursable at actual cost up to $150 per person.

5. RECEIPTS AND DOCUMENTATION
Receipts are required for all expenses over $25. For meals involving clients or colleagues, the names and business purpose must be noted. Expenses must be submitted within 30 days of incurrence; late submissions may be denied.

6. REIMBURSEMENT PROCESS
Expenses must be submitted through the expense management system. Approved expenses are reimbursed within 5-7 business days via direct deposit. Expenses submitted without receipts or over policy limits will require additional manager justification.

7. PROHIBITED EXPENSES
Non-business entertainment, personal travel extensions, first-class upgrades without approval, gifts over $50, personal care items, and traffic fines are not reimbursable.
